title: THE CROWBAR PAYS A PILLAGER THE SAME FROM BEHIND
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15, finding 14, and his answer 31 (consistent damage in pillager fights, no weak spots or bonus damage). v27.06 took the back shot bonus off rounds into a pillager, but the crowbar swing still did half again into a pillager back. It now does a pillager the same damage from every side. A machine still takes half again from behind, as before. The swing, its reach, its cooldown and its base damage are unchanged.
now: The crowbar does a pillager the same damage from behind as from the front.

edits.replacement: if(_me.kind!=='raider'&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(base-_me.face),Math.cos(base-_me.face)))<0.9) _mdm*=1.5;   // v27.xx (crowbar15), the cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 14) and his answer 31: no bonus damage on a pillager, from any side; a machine keeps its blow from behind
